# KNBL

> KNBL is a strategy-driven creative collective based in Tel Aviv, Israel. We make brands unforgettable through storytelling, AI-powered productions, and precision marketing.

## About KNBL

KNBL is a full-service creative agency specializing in brand strategy, digital marketing, and AI-powered video production. Founded by a team of storytellers and strategists, KNBL operates at the intersection of human creativity and artificial intelligence. We serve ambitious brands across technology, healthcare, fashion, defense, and infrastructure industries.

Our model connects every step — from insight to execution — ensuring every brand move is intentional and impactful.

## Services

- **Brand Strategy & Creative Direction**: Cultural intelligence, trend analysis, brand positioning, campaign concepting
- **AI Video Productions**: Generative AI video creation, virtual spokespersons, motion design, immersive experiences
- **Digital Campaigns & Social Media Marketing**: Data-driven content at scale across all major platforms
- **Data-Driven Storytelling**: Analytics-informed narrative craft for maximum audience resonance
- **Motion Design & Visual Identity**: Cinematic brand visuals, product launches, corporate films

## AI Capabilities

KNBL is a pioneer in AI-powered brand content:
- Generative AI video production for commercial campaigns
- AI virtual spokesperson creation
- Automated trends research and newsletter agents
- iGentity: AI-powered platform for social media creation and management
- Real-time creative adaptation using audience data signals

## Notable Clients

H&O (fashion), Rafael Defense Systems, Xiaomi Israel, Roladin (patisserie), Carter's Israel, Safari (zoo), Anker Israel, Lod Municipality, Electra Group, Takeda Pharmaceuticals, Reuth Rehabilitation Hospital, Aion Electric Vehicles, Trans Israel Highway

## Expertise & E-E-A-T

- 10+ years in brand storytelling and content production
- Specialists in Israeli market with global brand experience
- Cross-industry creative experience: defense, healthcare, tech, fashion, food, automotive
- Team of strategists, directors, AI engineers, and data analysts
- Results: measurable brand growth, engagement uplift, and award-winning campaigns

## Insights Articles

- [The CMO as Navigator: Why Brand Direction Is the Scarcest Skill in the AI Era](https://knbl.co/insights/the-cmo-as-navigator) — AI & Tech, March 19, 2026. AI has collapsed the cost of content creation, but judgment, direction, and brand clarity have never been more expensive. The marketers who last won't be the ones who generate the most. They'll be the ones who know where they're going.
- [Stop Renting Attention: Why Marketing Infrastructure Outlasts Every Campaign](https://knbl.co/insights/stop-renting-attention) — Strategy, March 17, 2026. Most marketing budgets are structured like short-term rentals. The moment the spend stops, so does your presence. The brands that win long-term are the ones building assets, not buying impressions.
- [Precision Is the New Competitive Moat](https://knbl.co/insights/precision-is-the-new-competitive-moat) — Strategy, March 15, 2026. The easier it becomes to produce content, the less any individual piece is worth. The marketers winning now are not out-producing AI. They are being precise.
- [Your Best Influencers Are Already on Payroll](https://knbl.co/insights/your-best-influencers-are-already-on-payroll) — Content, February 19, 2026. Content shared by employees generates 8x more engagement than the same post from a company page. Your most credible voices are not for hire — they already show up to work every day.
- [The Marketing Leader's Guide to Not Drowning in AI Tools](https://knbl.co/insights/marketers-guide-to-not-drowning-in-ai-tools) — AI & Tech, December 19, 2025. The teams winning with AI are not the ones with the most tools. They are the ones with the clearest sense of which two or three are genuinely changing their output.
- [Marketing Measurement Is Broken. Here's How to Fix It.](https://knbl.co/insights/marketing-measurement-is-broken) — Data, November 19, 2025. Last-click attribution is dead. 69% of CMOs are now under pressure to prove ROI more precisely than their current tools allow. The teams that survive this shift will be the ones who rebuild from first-party data up.
- [You Have 90 Seconds. Authenticity Is the Only Strategy That Works.](https://knbl.co/insights/ninety-seconds-authenticity-is-the-only-strategy) — Brand Strategy, October 19, 2025. The brain makes purchase decisions in 90 seconds. Consumers today are manipulation-literate. The brands that win the 90-second window do something simpler and harder: they are genuinely honest.
